exhaustive_proof: At the initial A, the only positive outgoing transition types are A->B and A->C, each available exactly once.
If the first transition is A->B, packet B has only the required B->A transition, after which the remaining unused transitions force A->C->A.
If the first transition is A->C, packet C forces C->A, after which the remaining unused transitions force A->B->A.
The two cases exhaust the first transition and produce distinct full ordered histories.
native_equality_statement: The two fiber elements remain natively unequal because their full ordered histories differ.
